actor.description: Deprecated legacy actor profile. MITRE ATT&CK tracks REvil as Software S0496 (a ransomware/RaaS family) and tracks GOLD SOUTHFIELD G0115 as the financially motivated group operating the REvil RaaS. REvil name mentions are therefore not materialized as a standalone canonical actor by census automation.
actor.analyst_notes: Retained only for legacy corpus references and stable actor--revil identifiers. Do not use this profile for canonical actor attribution.

attribution.assessment: Deprecated entity conflation; no state sponsor is asserted for this legacy profile.
attribution.analyst_notes: Previous Russia/state/espionage fields were generated from workbook geography and removed.

diamond_model.analyst_notes: Deprecated: REvil is treated as ransomware/RaaS software/brand context, while GOLD SOUTHFIELD is the ATT&CK group entity.

capabilities.analyst_notes: Legacy actor capabilities removed to avoid conflating REvil software/brand with operator identity.

sources.analyst_notes: Used to distinguish REvil Software S0496 from GOLD SOUTHFIELD Group G0115.

key_judgments.statement: REvil is deprecated as a standalone actor identity in this repository; MITRE models REvil as Software S0496 and GOLD SOUTHFIELD G0115 as the group operating the REvil RaaS.

uncertainties: Historical reporting may use 'REvil' colloquially for operators, affiliates, the RaaS brand, or the ransomware family; those scopes must be disambiguated per source.
assessment.collection_notes: Legacy evidence retained on disk for provenance, but the profile is removed from the active corpus catalog by actor-census-curation.json.

free_text.executive_summary: REvilは旧プロファイルをdeprecatedとして保持する。MITRE ATT&CKではREvilはSoftware S0496であり、REvil RaaSを運営するGroupはGOLD SOUTHFIELD G0115として分離される。
free_text.additional_notes: actor--revilは既存参照互換性のため保持するが、新規のActor帰属には使用しない。
